title: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 남구와 남동구, 동구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Change of Jurisdictional Areas between Nam-gu and Dong-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City)
(1) Lot Nos. 109-26, 109-75, 109-278, 109-793 through 109-802, 109-1351, 109-1361, 109-1363 through 109-1365, 109-1374, 109-1376 through 109-1379, 109-1384, 109-1386, 109-1388, 109-1432 through 109-1435, 110-14, 110-36 through 110-40, 110-63 through 110-66, 110-73, 457-52, and 460 in Sungui-dong, Nam-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City shall be excluded from the jurisdictional area of Nam-gu and incorporated into the jurisdictional area of Dong-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City.
(2) Lot Nos. 20-23 through 20-28, 20-40 through 20-45, 20-93 through 20-95, 20-97, and 21-49 in Dohwa-dong, Nam-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City shall be excluded from the jurisdictional area of Nam-gu and incorporated into the jurisdictional area of Dong-gu, Incheon Metropolitan City.
